0022600020.text: The Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East) come into this sixth game of their season on a two-game losing streak, with a 2-1 road record and an 0-2 mark at home, while the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) are 0-3 at home and riding a one-game winning streak. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring) and Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness) are day-to-day game-time decisions, while Miami has Simone Fontecchio listed day-to-day with an illness as a game-time decision. The Pacers won the last meeting 135-118 in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026, and took the 2025-26 season series 2-1, with no games between the teams yet this season.
